card.line: Megiddo was a city on the edge of the plain of Esdraelon, a famous battlefield where two kings of Judah, Ahaziah and Josiah, met their deaths.

moments.title: Ahaziah dies at Megiddo
moments.text: King Ahaziah of Judah fled from Jehu, and he was shot in his chariot. He escaped to Megiddo and died there. His servants then carried him to Jerusalem to be buried.

moments.title: Josiah goes to battle
moments.text: Neco of Egypt sent word that God had told him to hurry, and he warned Josiah to stop opposing God. Josiah did not listen. He disguised himself and went to fight on the Plain of Megiddo.

moments.title: Josiah is killed
moments.text: Pharaoh Neco killed King Josiah at Megiddo. His servants carried his body to Jerusalem, where he was buried in his own tomb. All Judah and Jerusalem mourned, and Jeremiah lamented for him.
